title: New Capenna Commander: card flavor text

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: A New Capenna crime boss who comments on a performance.

entities.name: Thiswick
entities.description: A place saved by Squire Imalia.

entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of choices creating the future.

entities.name: Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who gave Vraska a thaumatic compass and has disciples.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who followed Bolas's thaumatic compass into the River Heralds' trap.

entities.name: Talrand
entities.description: A mage who conquered the depths of Shandalar and then sought the sky.

entities.name: Zndrsplt
entities.description: A former official who teamed up with Okaun.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: An order of priests keeping order even in death.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A dragon whose mind is a dark labyrinth.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A city on Zendikar with a militia.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of nature and communion with animals.

entities.name: Herreth
entities.description: A poacher whose last words were about missing lightning.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker elf speaking of mana.

entities.name: Tajic
entities.description: A Boros leader who warns of the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: A city where everyone is a pawn in a play for power.

entities.name: Tullus of Palandius
entities.description: A Palandius speaker who relies on knowledge over dogma.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon leader of the Izzet League.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: A guild concerned with repayment and debt.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A guild of murder and revelry.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: A New Capenna crime family whose spies escape jail.

entities.name: Adversary
entities.description: A figure whose growing influence escalated conflicts between New Capenna's families.

events.summary: Vraska follows Bolas's thaumatic compass straight into the River Heralds' trap.
events.quote: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

events.summary: Talrand conquers the depths of Shandalar and turns his ambitions skyward.
events.quote: After Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, his ambitions drove him skyward, joined by servants whose drive and curiosity equaled his own.

events.summary: Zndrsplt retires from officiating after teaming up with Okaun.
events.quote: Zndrsplt retired from officiating when she teamed up with Okaun, but she still knows the penalties better than anyone else.

events.summary: As the Adversary's influence grows, conflicts between the families escalate.
events.quote: As the Adversary's influence grew, the conflicts between families escalated.

events.summary: Eldrazi spread across Zendikar, and its defenders seek any advantage.
events.quote: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.
